text:
alice: heads-up — saw weird QA blips on the new llm-12b-awq build when continuous batching + prefix prefetch are enabled. small repro but reproducible on staging.
ben: details? perf or quality?
alice: quality. eval harness (regression suite) shows ~+2.1% delta in next-token perplexity on the conversational set when we serve AWQ-int4 variant with prefetch_ttl=30s and batch_coalesce=enabled.
carla: hmm perplexity up with quant + prefetch? can you paste the light telemetry?
alice: pasted logs and a tiny trace below:
```
[2026-03-18T14:01:12Z] batch_coalesce: 8 -> merged
[2026-03-18T14:01:12Z] prefetch_lookup: hit (prefix_id=0x7f3c)
[2026-03-18T14:01:12Z] kvcache_serve: valid_until=1700000000 (stale)
[2026-03-18T14:01:12Z] model_decode: using stale kvrows -> token mismatch
```
ben: valid_until looks wrong. TTL arithmetic bug maybe (seconds vs ms)?
dana: we've seen TTL mismatch in dev before but usually it yields correctness drop only for fp16 not AWQ. could be quantized layout masking some checks.
evan: Also saw increased dropped-kv cache counter in infra metrics around the same time: `kvcache_evictions_rate +0.34` when coalescing >6.
carla: could this be a race between prefetch writer and batch consumer? e.g., prefetch writes partial kv page, batch consumer reads before writer finalizes and quantized decode misinterprets zeros as valid entries.
alice: that's my working hypothesis. repro steps: run 200 concurrent short-chats (prefix length 256) with awq-int4, prefetch_ttl=30, coalesce=enabled, continuous_batching=true. Fails ~3-6% of sessions.
infra-bot: deploy-check: no recent kernel/hw changes on staging GPUs. patchset 2026-03-17 applied: batching coalescer refactor.
ben: strong clue — refactor touched the flush/fence ordering. I'll run an instrumented build that adds a writer-fence and extra CRC on kv pages.
dana: can you also try fp8 (fp8-gptq) on the same config to confirm quantization-specific behavior? if fp8 doesn't fail, that points to AWQ layout fragility.
alice: good call. I ran fp8-gptq quick smoke: no regression in the same run. perplexity stable, kv_eviction stable.
evan: tentative root cause narrowed: coalescer changed memory visibility, AWQ-int4 decoder reads in smaller aligned chunks which occasionally see prefetch page with header zeroed. CRC will confirm.
carla: until patch, mitigations: disable continuous_batching for AWQ-int4 or bump prefetch_ttl to 120s? which has lower cost impact?
ben: quick math: disabling continuous batching increases 90th latency ~+18% under burst but reduces feed errors to ~0.1%. TTL bump increases memory pressure and slightly raises prefix cache churn but doesn't eliminate partial-write race.
dana: short-term: let's flip a config flag to opt-out AWQ-int4 from continuous batching in staging and run long evals. ben will run CRC-instrumented build and post results.
alice: created a minimal repro harness in the infra job: jobs/run_prefetch_race.sh (added to staging CI). I'll link the job when available.
evan: filed a ticket: INF-7283 with links to traces + perf counters.
carla: once we have CRC traces, we can decide whether to add a write-fence in runtime or tighten prefetch commit ordering. either way, AWQ-int4 needs special casing for now.
ben: will post instrumented run by EOD.
dana: thanks everyone — huge help. :thumbsup:
alice: thanks — I'll monitor the staging eval dashboard and loop back when infra build lands.
